d: Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has stepped down from his position as President and CEO with immediate effect. The company’s Chief Financial Officer, Colette Kress, has been named interim CEO while continuing to hold her existing responsibilities. Following the announcement, Nvidia’s shares dropped 10% in US premarket trading, further deepening the recent sell-off that has erased approximately $600 billion from the company’s market value this week. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
